title: The Getaway at Cabinberry Farm
description:
The Getaway at Cabinberry Farm is located just 11 miles from downtown Nashville in a scenic, retreat-like setting...perfect if you're looking for a spacious, private getaway.  We are 2 minutes from Beaman Park's hiking and nature trails and just 5 minutes from Fontanel's Greenspace and nature trails.

The space
Over 1,000 square feet encompasses a full king bedroom, living room with a full-sized pull-out sleeper sofa, bathroom, & kitchenette. You'll have your own private access and private porch. Our pool is closed for the winter, however it and the hot tub may be provided as an add-on.

Guest access
Nearly the entire private basement of our home will be made available for you.  You will have your own entry to the basement through our lower porch.
